text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: some EU provisioning webhooks started failing around 08:47 UTC with auth errors. I need a customer-friendly one-line RCA + a short mitigation note. Can engineering confirm root cause and whether we'll replay events?

Ravi (Eng): Root cause: automated certificate renewal for the EU onboarding connector failed due to a config drift, so connectors presented an expired cert and webhooks were rejected. Rotating certs now; ETA ~20m to restart and begin replay.

Priya (Ops): Created incident tag = eu-provisioning-hook-failure, flipping temporary ingress to accept retries during restart. Opening infra ticket and enabling replay window.

Deploy Bot: cert-rotate by priya-ops at 09:03 UTC; status: success.

Ravi (Eng): Connector restarted; queued webhook events will be replayed automatically for affected tenants (priority: open signup flows). Backlog ~80 events, estimate 10m to clear.

Maya (CS): Proposed customer note: "We experienced a brief interruption to EU onboarding caused by an expired certificate on our onboarding connector. We have rotated the certificate and are replaying missed webhook events. No action required on your part. We're applying a 7-day service credit and can set up a complimentary onboarding call if helpful." Need the exact one-line RCA to paste.

Ravi (Eng): One-line RCA: "An automated certificate renewal failed for our EU onboarding connector, causing expired certs and webhook authentication failures."

Liam (CS): I'll send that to affected accounts and tag renewal-risk customers for a follow-up. Will paste the sent copy here after send.

Ravi (Eng): Replay complete at 09:12 UTC; all queued events processed. Monitoring for errors for 30m. Filing postmortem to cover why renewal job regressed and adding alerts for cert age at T-7d and T-1d.

Priya (Ops): Credits applied and onboarding booking link added to affected account notes at 09:25 UTC.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. Liam, paste the outbound copy for records; Ravi/Priya please link the postmortem when ready so CS can share a customer-facing RCA. Thread will be closed after CS confirmations.
